name: Synthesis of [Co(ttpp)(py)2](OTf) (scale-up)
plain_text_description:
Reference: AD-R13; 3x scale
Analysis
1H NMR: [Co(ttpp)(py)₂](OTf) (85% purity), hexane (0.4 eq, 1.7% w/w) (D1 1 s was enough)
ICP-OES: Co w/w 4.97% (calcd. 2.93%) → Contradicting 1H NMR and CHN. Sample preparation or measurement failure?
ICP-OES: Ag/Co atomic ratio 0.00012 
CHN: 0.4 n-hexane, 2 H2O (4% w/w)
Co(II) 10%?

Procedure
RT 21.8°C RH 30 %
Stock solution preparation
5 mL vial
Put into the glovebox (H₂O < 1 ppm)
Weigh in AgOTf → 80.26 mg
Take it out of the glovebox. 
Add 3000 µL of toluene → colorless solution.

Reaction
25 mL flask
Add Co(ttpp)
Add pyridine
Add toluene 15 mL
Sonicate for 3 min → Dark red solution 
Cover with aluminum foil
Start stirring at 400 rpm
Add  1500 µL of AgOTf/toluene dropwise w/ mechanical pipette (750 x 2)
Continue stirring for 1 h
-> 50 μL + CDCl₃ 450 μL -> 1H NMR M1 (U1.834; SW 19, NS 16) (use mechanical pipette)
plain_text_observation:
Ag scavenging
Remove volatiles with a rotovap (40 °C) for 1 h.
Dry under vacuum 1h
Add DCM 15 mL
Swirl and sonicate → Dark green solution
Add ISOLUTE Si-Thiol
Stir at 500 rpm for 2 h
20 mL plastic syringe, cotton plug, syringe filter (⌀ 25 mm, 0.45 µm, PTFE), syringe filter (0.2 µm, ⌀ 15 mm, PTFE), 250 mL RBF [difficult to press]. Better to use frit or a filter paper.
Filter the mixture → Dark green filtrate collected
Transfer and rinse with DCM 50 mL → pale green filtrate at the end.
Evaporate the whole solvent. 

Reprecipitation
Add 10 mL of DCM.
Add n-hexane (60 mL).
Swirl and sonicate
Refrigerate at 0 °C for o/n
26.03.2026 RT 21.5°C RH 30 %
Membrane filter (0.22 µm, hydrophobic, PVDF), membrane filter holder, 250 mL RBF.
Filter the mixture [it was too slow and incomplete]
Dissolve in 30 mL of DCM
Evaporate the whole solvent. 
Add 10 mL of DCM.
Add n-hexane (60 mL).
Refrigerate at 0 °C for 2 h
Frit (por. 4)
Filter the mixture →  light yellow filtrate
Transfer and rinse with 2 x (DCM 3 mL + n-hexane 20 mL)
Rinse w/ hexane 4 x 4 mL
Dry w/ suction for 5 min
Dry under vacuum o/n

2nd reprecipitation
?

Analysis
2026-03-27 RT 22.6 °C RH 26%
Vial (tare 15.40368 g)
Transfer
→ Weigh: 0.28554 g
→ 2 mg → 1H NMR P (CDCl3; U1.834, SW 19, NS 16) [next time with internal standard and 19F]
2026-04-01
→ 9.02 mg into a PTFE microwave tube
Add 4 g of HNO3 aq (65%, chemically pure, Buchmeiser Group)
Add 1 g of H2O2 aq (33%. p.a., Buchmeiser Group)
Wait for 20 min
Seal
Microwave heating (CEM Mars 6, program: xxx, 200 °C for ca 3.5 h; cool down to RT, 2 h) (time not sure because of machine trouble); observe colorless solution
Transfer to 10 mL volumetric flask with DI water and fill up to 10.00 mL
o/n
Transfer to test tube
→ ICP-OES (0.517, Agilent 5800; Co, Ag)
→ 2.00 mL
test tube
Add 8.00 mL of DI water
→ ICP-OES
2026-04-13
→ ca. 1.00 mg into a 2 mL centrifuge tube
Add ca. 1.00 mg durene 
Add 550 µL of CDCl3
Sonicate until dissolved
Transfer to an NMR tube
→ 1H NMR P (U1.834, N PROTON15ppm, D1 1/12/24)
